title: RNA-sequencing from paired plasma, tumor and sentinel lymph node samples from breast cancer patients
description: RNA-sequencing from 30 breast cancer patients, which included paired samples of plasma (n=30) and sentinel lymph node (n=32). In 7 patients, tumor tissue was also available for comparison
